lyrics:
[Intro: plucked guitar loop, distant gulls]

[Verse 1: low weary male baritone]
You go out and I don't ask where
Sand gets wide, boats lean in the air
Used to chase you down the beach
Now I let the water reach

[Chorus: soft beat enters, bass warm]
I'm low tide company
Good with me when you're away
Crabs and gulls and a mile of gray
You come back at six, like you do
I'm low tide company
And high tide, I'm with you

[Verse 2: voice closer, hi-hat ticking]
I'm the pier, I don't go
Barnacles and all, you know
You bring in what you bring
I hold still for everything

[Chorus: soft beat, bass warm, harmony below]
I'm low tide company
Good with me when you're away
Crabs and gulls and a mile of gray
You come back at six, like you do
I'm low tide company
And high tide, I'm with you

[Break: guitar loop alone, hummed melody]
Mm, mm, mm

[Final Chorus: full beat, strings underneath]
I'm low tide company
Good with me when you're away
Crabs and gulls and a mile of gray
You come back at six, like you do
I'm low tide company
And high tide, I'm with you

[Outro: guitar loop, water coming in]
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 120 BPM, 4/4, G minor. Calm, steady and melancholy deep house.

VOICE: Male baritone, low, grainy and tired, sung quietly with almost no vibrato. A second, lower harmony in the later choruses. He hums the break.

INSTRUMENTS: A short plucked acoustic guitar loop that never changes, a soft kick on every beat, a muted clap, shakers, a warm sustained bass, a quiet string pad from the last chorus, gull and water sounds at the ends.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, guitar loop. 0:16 Verse 1. 0:48 Chorus 1, beat in. 1:16 Verse 2. 1:48 Chorus 2. 2:16 Break, guitar and humming. 2:32 Final chorus. 2:58 Outro, guitar and water, ends 3:08.

PRODUCTION & MIX: 2014 radio deep house: soft, mid-range and close, the guitar dry, the beat gentle, the voice right in the ear.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: 'And high tide, I'm with you' at 1:10, the only hopeful line, sung no louder than the rest.

STATION FIT: 7:30 p.m., as the deck empties. The saddest song in the pack, placed at dusk where a little melancholy feels right.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Resigned, steady, self-sufficient, quietly faithful.
